rows.comment: Object-like `#define Simplify DontCallSimplify` applies only AT/AFTER its directive (C preprocessor semantics). The out-of-line def ABOVE it keeps the real name — outline labels it Simplify/Method/Regexp, never the expanded DontCallSimplify (re2 simplify.cc shape).

An `#ifndef X` / `#define X` include guard is compilation plumbing, not a program entity — folded from the outline (still goto-def-able). The guard name POSMACRO_H_ never appears as a Variable symbol.
